program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cells (filter (lambda (p) p)
                                 (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                                   (and (!= (at g r c) 7) (list r c (at g r c))))))
                  (base (recolor-cells g cells 7)))
             (reduce (lambda (acc cell)
                       (let* ((cr (first cell))
                              (cc (second cell))
                              (cv (third cell))
                              (top (zero? cr))
                              (left (zero? cc))
                              (dr (if top 1 -1))
                              (dc (if left 1 -1))
                              (new-cells (if top
                                             (list (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc dc))
                                                   (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc (* 2 dc)))
                                                   (list (+ cr (* 2 dr)) (+ cc dc))
                                                   (list (+ cr (* 2 dr))
                                                         (+ cc (* 2 dc))))
                                             (list (list (+ cr (* 3 dr))
                                                         (+ cc (* 2 dc)))
                                                   (list (+ cr (* 2 dr))
                                                         (+ cc (* 2 dc)))
                                                   (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc (* 3 dc)))))))
                         (recolor-cells acc new-cells cv)))
                     base
                     cells)))))
